Woodstove Sudoku: Large Print Winter Sudoku

  • 160 winter-themed sudoku, one big puzzle per page
  • Four levels: 40 Easy, 40 Medium, 40 Hard and 40 Very Hard
  • Large digits, roomy squares and thick 3 x 3 box lines
  • Every puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable by logic alone
  • Plain-English tips and all the answers at the back
